title: Version Hopping
deferred_reason: Operator instruction: skip and deprioritize version hopping while the late-stage release work remains active.
objective: Create a safe dry-run-first version-hopping lane that lets the operator inspect, plan, check, and explicitly apply compatible version-profile switches across LeafOS and FlowerOS release planes without rewriting historical evidence or confusing operator-surface identity with engine contracts.
constraints: FlowerOS remains the operator-facing surface and LeafOS remains the execution and evidence engine.
A version hop must name the affected plane: root package, taskpack, work-order schema, runtime, or evidence compatibility.
Every hop is dry-run first and requires explicit approval before mutation.
A hop must not rewrite historical work orders, reports, benchmarks, run directories, or durable evidence objects.
Durable leafos.* object names, version-2 work-order runs, queue state, journals, checkpoints, and reports remain readable.
Runtime and provider-role changes must preserve the coding-only coder boundary and main/scheduler pool boundary.
Do not display or persist private model chain-of-thought.
acceptance: The version-hop registry reports the current root package, taskpack, work-order schema, runtime, and evidence planes.
The list, show, plan, check, and apply command shape is available from both Bash and PowerShell leafctl surfaces.
Planning a hop emits JSON without mutating files.
Checking a hop rejects incompatible schema, runtime, provider-role, and path-policy changes.
Applying a hop requires explicit approval and writes only declared version-hop state or config changes.
Existing versions, live project, TUI, and FlowerOS home commands remain intact.
Version-2 work-order runs remain resumable after a hop.
Historical work orders, reports, benchmarks, and run directories are not rewritten.
Focused dispatch, work-order, live-project, and model-profile tests pass.

verification.reason: Operator instructed that version hopping be skipped and deprioritized; no implementation or test run is claimed.
